claim_boundary: Provisional PINDER-train-only antibody adaptation split design. It is not authorized for training or model selection until an independent exhaustive exact four-view Needleman-Wunsch audit reports zero qualifying train-validation crossings. It is not a performance evaluation, temporal test, structural split, or PLM pretraining leakage audit.

determinism.largest_component_tie_break: highest original exact-pair degree, then lexical component root

discard_policy: Discard a complete PDB-and-exact-pair connected component whenever its antibody and antigen axis components are assigned to different buckets. Never split a PDB or exact antibody-antigen sequence pair across train, validation, and discarded ledgers.

known_similarity_evidence.base: Authenticated MMseqs2 S2-80 concatenated-antibody and antigen components from the failed parent assignment.
known_similarity_evidence.exact_extension: All 6802 digest-only threshold crossings from the independent parent four-view audit, with VH and VL edges lifted to concatenated-antibody entities; exact shared VH and non-empty VL digests are also indivisible.
known_similarity_evidence.iteration_rule: If the independent audit of this replacement split finds a new crossing, add only the authenticated digest-only crossing relation, rerun under this unchanged protocol, and never relax 80/80 or inspect labels/scores.

objective: maximize retained unique exact antibody-antigen sequence pairs across train and validation
required_final_gate: independent exhaustive exact global four-view Needleman-Wunsch train-validation zero-crossing audit
